title: The Second Test
evidence_boundary: The Second Test is an original philosophical framing, not a new validated definition or a claim of unprecedented discovery. Scenes 9–11 summarize Bastani et al., PNAS 2025, doi:10.1073/pnas.2422633122, a high-school mathematics randomized study; its findings apply to those study conditions and distinguish assisted performance from unassisted learning. The published correction updates an author affiliation, not results. The two workshops are an imagined analogy. CNC and classroom stock illustrate the concepts and do not document an AI-controlled factory or the study's participants. Behavioral effects do not establish subjective experience.
desired_movement: From fascination with an AI's answers toward curiosity about what its help makes possible for a person.
grounding: Return to the viewer's table, their hands, and a pencil they can use.
invitation: After the answer... what can you see that you couldn't see before?
end_card_question: After the answer... what can you see that you couldn't see before?
voice_standard: Liam - warm, sly, a brilliant friend at midnight; spacious and intimate through the turn, near-whisper on the closing question.

scenes.text: An AI can finish your sentence. Can it change what you're able to notice afterward?
scenes.query: laptop with an AI chat interface generating a reply on its screen, stable desk framing
scenes.symbol_query: laptop with an AI chat interface generating a reply on its screen, stable desk framing

scenes.text: A stranger intelligence test than another question we already know how to grade.
scenes.query: pencil marking answers on an exam paper on a desk
scenes.symbol_query: pencil marking answers on an exam paper on a desk

scenes.text: Learning. Reasoning. Handling the unfamiliar. Useful clues to intelligence; there isn't one universally accepted definition.
scenes.query: hands fitting a piece into a jigsaw puzzle
scenes.symbol_query: hands fitting a piece into a jigsaw puzzle

scenes.text: Picture two workshops. Same tools, same unfinished chair. You arrive with shaky hands.
scenes.query: wide view of a carpenter working in a wood workshop with timber and a workbench
scenes.symbol_query: wide view of a carpenter working in a wood workshop with timber and a workbench

scenes.text: In the first, a machine builds it while you watch. Perfect joints. You're impressed.
scenes.query: CNC wood carving machine cutting a wooden workpiece in a workshop
scenes.symbol_query: CNC wood carving machine cutting a wooden workpiece in a workshop

scenes.text: In the second, it helps you discover why wood splits against the grain.
scenes.query: close-up of a chisel moving through wood grain and lifting small shavings
scenes.symbol_query: close-up of a chisel moving through wood grain and lifting small shavings

scenes.text: Both produce a chair. One also changes what you can do tomorrow.
scenes.query: a carpenter working on a wooden chair in a workshop
scenes.symbol_query: a carpenter working on a wooden chair in a workshop

scenes.text: Here's my proposed second test: what does an intelligence make possible beyond itself?
scenes.query: a young seedling growing in soil in a time lapse
scenes.symbol_query: a young seedling growing in soil in a time lapse

scenes.text: One mathematics study found that unrestricted AI help improved students' practice performance.
scenes.query: student writing mathematical equations in a notebook
scenes.symbol_query: student writing mathematical equations in a notebook

scenes.text: After access ended, those students performed worse independently than students who'd practiced without it.
scenes.query: student writing answers on an exam paper independently
scenes.symbol_query: student writing answers on an exam paper independently

scenes.text: A tutor designed to safeguard learning largely avoided that loss. Design changed the outcome.
scenes.query: student using a laptop beside a mathematics notebook at a desk
scenes.symbol_query: student using a laptop beside a mathematics notebook at a desk

scenes.text: A better chair doesn't automatically mean a more capable carpenter.
scenes.query: carpenter measuring a wood plank with a ruler
scenes.symbol_query: carpenter measuring a wood plank with a ruler

scenes.text: Sometimes you just need the chair. Your washing machine can keep its lecture on personal growth.
scenes.query: colorful clothes spinning inside a washing machine drum
scenes.symbol_query: colorful clothes spinning inside a washing machine drum

scenes.text: But when understanding matters, the hidden question changes: did the task improve, or did your grip?
scenes.query: carpenter gripping a chisel and carefully carving wood at a workbench
scenes.symbol_query: carpenter gripping a chisel and carefully carving wood at a workbench

scenes.text: Maybe intelligence has a footprint beyond the system displaying it. A capacity left in someone else.
scenes.query: footprints left in sand as a person walks away
scenes.symbol_query: footprints left in sand as a person walks away

scenes.text: A sharper question. A mistake you can finally recognize. A method you can carry away.
scenes.query: a pencil eraser removing a mistaken mark from paper
scenes.symbol_query: a pencil eraser removing a mistaken mark from paper

scenes.text: That's an effect worth measuring. It doesn't establish consciousness or replace tests of the machine's abilities.
scenes.query: close-up of an electronic circuit board and processor in changing practical light
scenes.symbol_query: close-up of an electronic circuit board and processor in changing practical light

scenes.text: And help can remain available. Instructions, tools, other people: your workshop has always contained more than you.
scenes.query: two carpenters working together over a plan at a workbench
scenes.symbol_query: two carpenters working together over a plan at a workbench

scenes.text: Can you inspect the joint, question the plan, and choose what you're building?
scenes.query: carpenter inspecting a wooden joint and checking its fit
scenes.symbol_query: carpenter inspecting a wooden joint and checking its fit

scenes.text: Back in this room, feel the table beneath your hands. Someone learned to make that.
scenes.query: a hand moving across the grain of a solid wood tabletop
scenes.symbol_query: a hand moving across the grain of a solid wood tabletop

scenes.text: You can borrow a result or gain a possibility. Different needs, different kinds of help.
scenes.query: a craftsperson choosing a tool from an open toolbox
scenes.symbol_query: a craftsperson choosing a tool from an open toolbox

scenes.text: An answer closes a task. A good encounter might open a capacity.
scenes.query: a wooden interior door opening into a lit workshop
scenes.symbol_query: a wooden interior door opening into a lit workshop

scenes.text: That's the second test. The page is finished. The pencil is still in your hand.
scenes.query: close-up of an adult hand holding a pencil and drawing on paper
scenes.symbol_query: close-up of an adult hand holding a pencil and drawing on paper

scenes.text: After the answer... what can you see that you couldn't see before?

scenes.symbol_query: a hand using a magnifying glass to examine the detail on a page
